metaTitle: Custom Vinyl Luggage Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Brand custom vinyl luggage accessories for your team or event. Durable, waterproof tags and more at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Vinyl luggage accessories offer a durable, waterproof option for branding your team's travel gear. Unlike paper or fabric tags, vinyl resists tearing and moisture, making it ideal for frequent travelers and outdoor events. Custom-print your logo on items like the Rectangle Write-On Surface Luggage Tag for clear identification that lasts. Perfect for corporate travel gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition kits.
heroAltText: Custom vinyl luggage accessories with a branded luggage tag featuring a write-on surface and durable vinyl construction.
